entries.name: Topbar
entries.customization: Use h-14 height, border-b border-border, background bg-background with subtle shadow-sm. Brand mark on left, center search trigger (input-group with icon), right side avatar with dropdown menu. Font size text-sm, font-medium. Accent color on active nav item.

entries.name: Sidebar
entries.customization: Width w-64, border-r border-border, bg-background. Use space-y-1 for nav items, each item h-9 rounded-md px-3 text-sm font-medium. Active item has bg-primary text-primary-foreground. Icons use text-muted-foreground. Collapsible on mobile.

entries.name: FilterTabs
entries.description: Tabs to filter the queue by status.
entries.customization: Use default tabs with h-9 trigger, rounded-md, bg-muted text-muted-foreground. Active tab bg-background shadow-sm. Border border-border. Font size text-sm font-medium. Use data-state=active for styling.

entries.name: PriorityFilter
entries.customization: Use h-9, rounded-md, border-border bg-background text-sm. Font-medium. Icon on right. Use ring-ring on focus.

entries.name: AssigneeFilter
entries.customization: Use h-9, rounded-md, border-border bg-background text-sm. Font-medium. Icon on right. Use ring-ring on focus.

entries.name: TicketTable
entries.description: Table displaying the queue of tickets.
entries.customization: Use TableHeader with bg-muted text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground. Rows h-12 border-b border-border. Hover bg-accent. Font size text-sm. First column priority badge, then subject, customer, status, assignee, timer. Use sticky header.

tickets.type: {id:string, priority:string, subject:string, customer:string, status:string, assignee:string, timer:string}[]

entries.name: TicketRowActions
entries.customization: Trigger is icon button size h-8 w-8 rounded-md hover:bg-accent. Menu items h-9 px-3 text-sm font-medium, rounded-md. Separator between groups. Use text-destructive for destructive actions.

entries.name: PriorityBadge
entries.customization: Use rounded-full, px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold. Color variants: urgent bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground, high bg-orange-100 text-orange-800, medium bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800, low bg-muted text-muted-foreground.

entries.name: StatusBadge
entries.customization: Use rounded-md, px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium. Color variants: new bg-blue-100 text-blue-800, open bg-green-100 text-green-800, pending bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800, resolved bg-muted text-muted-foreground.

entries.name: TimerBadge
entries.customization: Use rounded-md, px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono. For urgent timers, bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground. For normal, bg-muted text-muted-foreground. Show remaining time.

entries.name: QueueEmpty
entries.customization: Use flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16. Icon in rounded-full bg-muted p-4. Title text-lg font-heading. Description text-sm text-muted-foreground max-w-sm text-center. Button mt-4.

entries.name: AssignDialog
entries.customization: Use fixed overlay bg-black/50, dialog content max-w-sm rounded-lg bg-background p-6 shadow-lg. Title font-heading text-lg. Use h-10 primary button for confirm and h-10 outline button for cancel.

entries.name: ThreadTitle
entries.description: Displays conversation subject and customer name.
entries.customization: Use bg-transparent border-0 shadow-none p-0. Subject text-xl font-heading. Customer name text-sm text-muted-foreground.

entries.name: QuickActions
entries.description: Actions to change status or assign.
entries.customization: Use h-9 buttons with rounded-md border border-border bg-background. Active state bg-primary text-primary-foreground. Use icons for statuses.

entries.name: MessageList
entries.description: List of messages in a conversation.
entries.customization: MessageList (product-specific): use the 6px radius language (rounded-* family) for corners, #C2410C accent only on the active/primary state with #9A3412 on interactive hover, standard control heights (h-9/h-10) with padding from the spacing scale, and type at "DM Sans", sans-serif weights with "Space Grotesk", sans-serif reserved for display moments.

entries.name: MessageItem
entries.customization: Use flex gap-3. Avatar size h-9 w-9 rounded-full. Content in bg-card rounded-lg p-4 border border-border. Sender name text-sm font-medium. Timestamp text-xs text-muted-foreground. Body text-sm leading-relaxed.

entries.name: InternalNote
entries.customization: Use bg-accent border-accent rounded-lg p-4. Add a small label 'Internal note' with icon. Text size sm. Use dashed border to differentiate.

entries.name: ReplyTextarea
entries.customization: Use min-h-[120px] rounded-md border-border bg-background p-3 text-sm. Focus ring ring-ring. Placeholder text-muted-foreground.

entries.name: SendButton
entries.customization: Use h-10 px-4 rounded-md bg-primary text-primary-foreground font-medium. Hover bg-primary/90. Focus ring ring-ring. Disabled opacity-50.

entries.name: NoteToggle
entries.description: Toggle between public reply and internal note.
entries.customization: Use h-9 rounded-md border border-border bg-background. Active item bg-primary text-primary-foreground. Use icons.

entries.name: AssigneeSelect
entries.customization: Use h-9 w-full rounded-md border-border bg-background text-sm. Font-medium. Icon on right.

entries.name: TagInput
entries.description: Input to add or remove tags.
entries.customization: Use h-9 rounded-md border-border bg-background. Tag chips appear inside with remove icon. Use flex-wrap.

entries.name: SlaTimer
entries.customization: Use h-2 rounded-full bg-muted. Indicator bg-primary. If overdue, bg-destructive. Show text with remaining time.

entries.name: CustomerInfo
entries.description: Customer details such as email and company.
entries.customization: Use bg-card rounded-lg border border-border p-4. Title text-sm font-medium. Details text-sm text-muted-foreground. Use avatar with initials.
